review.notes: Match the confirmed incident using a saved frontend record and the exact selected conversation. Review the existing CLI executable search as well so standard non-standalone installations retain managed restore. Exercise the real restore dispatch and a real CLI process without a TTY. Receipt tests inject evidence at the existing live frontend verification boundary. Use private state and fake senders. App behavior against a newly installed binary is a separate device check.

cases.description: Restoring a saved managed Codex thread preserves its terminal bridge
cases.setup: A private restore fixture records an exact Codex conversation, with or without a managed frontend. The pane, selected binary and tmux sender are controlled.
cases.action: Dispatch the managed restore with a standalone package and with a verified CLI symlink outside the standalone layout. Attempt them again in the same boot and compare with standalone Codex and managed records whose binary or route cannot be verified.
cases.expected: Managed dispatch reserves the attempt before sending the exact same thread through gtmux codex with the verified binary and home. A verified non-standalone executable still uses the managed route. Unavailable routes send zero input. A same-boot rerun sends zero input. Standalone Codex keeps its original command.

cases.description: A managed restore launch without a usable terminal bridge reports failure
cases.setup: Start a subprocess with a private home and a stub executable named codex that would leave a marker if run. Use the actual Codex CLI command handler with no TTY.
cases.action: Invoke the generated managed route through the handler, then invoke ordinary gtmux codex using the same stub.
cases.expected: The managed route reports that the bridge is unavailable and never invokes the stub. Ordinary launch still executes the stub.

cases.description: Managed startup confirmation requires a fresh exact live attachment
cases.setup: Create a real pending restore reservation in a private home. Feed verified frontend evidence through an isolated lookup and model native, stale, retired, mismatching and unverified attachments.
cases.action: Poll confirmation using the exact live result and each mismatching receipt.
cases.expected: Only a new attachment for the same thread, home, pane and physical terminal records confirmation. Pending state survives all mismatches. An already off-path attempt cannot be confirmed.
